records.text: The FBI announced that it found the passport of one of the hijackers who was aboard one of the planes that hit the Twin Towers.
records.speaker: Rick Leventhal

appearances.snippet: The FBI announcing that it has found the passport of one of the hijackers who was on board one of those two planes that hit the Twin Towers on Tuesday morning.

verification.notes: Transcript context matches the claim. The 9/11 Commission record and contemporaneous UPI reporting confirm that Satam al-Suqami's passport was recovered near the World Trade Center and that the FBI announced the recovery; wording about being aboard the plane is consistent with its identification as a hijacker passport.

sources.title: National Commission on Terrorist Attacks Upon the United States - Public Hearing
sources.relevance: Official commission record says Satam al-Suqami's passport was picked up near the World Trade Center before the towers collapsed.

sources.title: Hijacker passport found blocks from scene
sources.relevance: Contemporaneous report records the FBI announcement and identifies the recovered hijacker passport.
